summary: GlobalFoundries filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting preliminary Q1 2026 financial results. Revenue was $1.634 billion, gross margin 27.6%, net income $104 million, diluted EPS $0.18. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or special situation is described. The filing also notes business highlights including a strategic partnership with Renesas and technology launches. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event.
